name: life-os
description: Local-first personal operating system. No build step and no runtime dependencies; these scripts are for development only.

scripts.test: npm run lint && npm run test:unit && npm run test:e2e
scripts.test:e2e: for t in smoke phase0 phase1 phase2 today capture rituals plan body reflect progression ceremonies phase3 phase4 phase5 phase6 phase12 phase13c phase13d phase13e phase13f workout-notes journey day-plan sync resilience a11y visual hardening; do NODE_PATH=$(npm root -g) node tests/$t.mjs || exit 1; done
